payload.name: AINSOF
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AINSOF helps filmmakers and creators find original production music, discover similar tracks from a reference, analyze video for soundtrack recommendations, preview tracks, build cue sheets, and request track delivery or licensing support.
payload.longDescription: AINSOF 帮助电影制作人和创作者寻找原创制作音乐、根据参考发现相似曲目、分析视频以推荐配乐、试听曲目、制作音乐使用清单，并请求曲目交付或授权支持。

payload.name: Embroidery File Converter
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Digitize PNG, JPG, SVG, and WebP artwork into embroidery designs, or convert existing embroidery files between machine formats such as PES, DST, JEF, VP3, EXP, and more. Upload a file to create a private stitch preview, then review thread-rendered stitches, dimensions, thread colours, warnings, and production metrics in ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: 将PNG、JPG、SVG和WebP格式的图像数字化为刺绣设计，或在PES、DST、JEF、VP3、EXP等机器格式之间进行文件转换。上传文件以创建私有刺绣预览，随后在ChatGPT中查看线材渲染的刺绣效果、尺寸参数、线色配置、系统警告及生产指标。

payload.name: Butter
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Butter is the video editor that lets you and your team collaborate with AI. The Butter MCP can pull in your assets and context and help you create ads with professional motion. You can continue to edit any Butter project in the browser with full manual control: change copy, move things around on canvas, retime on the timeline, and more. Use AI to help you move fast, and never lose control or quality.
payload.longDescription:
Butter是支持你和团队通过AI协作的视频编辑器。
Butter MCP可整合您的素材和上下文，帮助您创建具备专业动态效果的广告。
您可以在浏览器中对任何Butter项目进行编辑，保持完整的手动控制：修改文案、在画布上移动元素、在时间线上重新安排顺序等。
利用AI加速工作流程，同时始终确保控制权和品质不受影响。

payload.name: Sonilo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Generate fully licensed AI music, background music, sound effects, and video soundtracks from a simple prompt or a public video link. Sonilo can match audio to your video, keep speech clear, mix music or sound effects into a new video, and automatically lower background music under voiceovers. Use it for social videos, product demos, podcasts, ads, games, presentations, and more.
payload.longDescription: 只需输入简单提示或公开视频链接，即可生成完全授权的 AI 音乐、背景音乐、音效和视频配乐。Sonilo 可以为视频匹配音频、保持语音清晰、将音乐或音效混入新视频，并在旁白播放时自动降低背景音乐音量。可用于社交视频、产品演示、播客、广告、游戏、演示文稿等。

payload.name: ShotClick
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
ShotClick is a screenplay editor: professional formatting, locked scene numbers, revision passes, production breakdown, and .fdx import and export.

This plugin lets ChatGPT work inside the script itself instead of returning loose text. It reads your projects, scenes, subject, treatment, outline, characters, research notes and comments, and writes back properly formatted scenes, loglines, treatments and outline beats. Your existing permissions apply: on a shared project, a viewer stays read-only through the plugin too.

It can open a "what if" branch from any scene, so an alternate version of the story is written in parallel without touching the original. It also reaches AI Studio, the screenplay-to-video pipeline: it looks at the generated keyframes and reference images, then writes the image and video prompts that match them.

No tool deletes anything — not a scene, not a project, not a note — and no tool spends AI credits. Connecting requires a ShotClick account on the Studio plan, which includes the MCP connector.
payload.longDescription:
ShotClick 是一款剧本编辑器，提供专业排版、锁定场景编号、修订轮次、制作拆解，以及 .fdx 导入和导出功能。

该插件让 ChatGPT 直接在剧本中工作，而不是只返回零散文本。它可以读取你的项目、场景、主题、故事梗概、故事大纲、角色、研究笔记和评论，并将格式规范的场景、宣传短句、故事梗概和大纲要点写回剧本。沿用你现有的权限：在共享项目中，查看者通过插件仍只能只读访问。

它可以从任意场景创建一个“如果这样会怎样”的分支，让故事的另一种版本并行写出而不影响原稿。它还可连接 AI Studio（剧本转视频工作流）：查看生成的关键帧和参考图像，然后编写与之匹配的图像和视频提示词。

任何工具都不会删除内容——无论是场景、项目还是笔记；也不会消耗 AI 积分。连接需要 ShotClick Studio plan 账户，该方案包含 MCP 连接器。

payload.name: Clueso
payload.description: 通过提示编辑或创建视频
payload.summaryOriginal: Edit or create video by prompt
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Clueso MCP gives Chatgpt a complete video production toolbox, connected to your Clueso workspace. Clueso turns screen recordings, slide decks, documents, or a plain prompt into finished videos and step-by-step written guides; this connector puts all of it in the chat.

What Chatgpt can do with it:
• Create - build a project from a prompt, a screen recording, a slide deck, or a document
• Compose - place text, callouts, shapes, images, motion graphics and stock footage across a timeline
• Narrate - write scripts and generate voiceover from a library of 350+ voices, synced to on-screen action
• Edit - make targeted changes to any clip, element or word without rebuilding the project
• Preview - render any frame as an image to check the result mid-conversation
• Publish - export the finished video, and build the written article from the same source
• Reuse - save any project as a template so the next video inherits its structure and branding

Because it runs through your assistant, it composes with whatever else you have connected pull a script from meeting notes, a feature list from a project tracker, or account detail from a CRM, and build the video from material that already exists.

Typical uses: product and feature walkthroughs, customer education libraries, internal training built from existing decks, launch and changelog videos, help-centre articles paired with video.

Everything the connector creates opens in the Clueso editor and stays fully editable.
payload.longDescription:
Clueso MCP 为 ChatGPT 提供完整的视频制作工具箱，并连接到您的 Clueso 工作区。Clueso 可以将屏幕录制、幻灯片、文档或简单提示转换成成片视频和分步书面指南；此连接器将全部功能带入聊天。

ChatGPT 可以：
• 创建——根据提示、屏幕录制、幻灯片或文档构建项目
• 编排——在时间轴上放置文字、标注、形状、图像、动态图形和素材
• 配音——编写脚本并从 350+ 声音库生成与屏幕动作同步的旁白
• 编辑——针对任意片段、元素或词语进行修改，无需重建项目
• 预览——将任意帧渲染为图像，在对话中途检查结果
• 发布——导出成片，并从同一来源生成文章
• 复用——将项目保存为模板，让下一个视频继承其结构和品牌

由于它通过助手运行，可以与其他已连接内容组合：从会议记录提取脚本、从项目跟踪器提取功能列表，或从 CRM 提取账户详情，用已有材料制作视频。

典型用途包括产品和功能演示、客户教育库、根据现有演示文稿制作内部培训、发布与更新日志视频，以及配套视频的帮助中心文章。连接器创建的所有内容都会在

Clueso 编辑器中打开，并保持完全可编辑。

payload.name: Quickads
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: QuickAds helps you research successful ads, discover trending hooks, and turn insights into new campaigns. Create AI images and videos, publish posts, launch ad campaigns, run automated agents, and analyze the performance of your content, ads, and ad accounts - all from one place.
payload.longDescription: QuickAds 可帮助你研究成功的广告、发现热门创意切入点，并将洞察转化为新营销活动。创建 AI 图片和视频、发布帖子、启动广告活动、运行自动化智能体，并在一个地方分析内容、广告和广告账户的表现。

payload.name: AdKraft
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AdKraft turns product photos into finished video ads. Give it a product name, a short description and a product photo (attach it in the chat or paste a link), and it writes the script, generates the footage with a voiceover in any of 16 languages and hands back an MP4 you can post, in portrait, square or landscape, usually in under a minute. Ads are made on your own AdKraft account and use its credits; new accounts start with free credits, and you can check the balance or list the ads you have made without leaving the chat.
payload.longDescription: AdKraft可将产品照片转化为完整视频广告。向它提供产品名称、简短描述和产品图片（可通过聊天上传附件或粘贴链接），它会撰写脚本，用16种语言中的一种生成带配音的视频素材，并返回可直接发布的MP4格式文件，支持竖屏、方形或横屏模式，通常在一分钟内完成。广告内容会保存在您的AdKraft账户中并消耗账户积分；新账户初始包含免费积分，您无需离开聊天界面即可查看余额或列出已制作的广告。

payload.name: Ullbek
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Describe your business or idea in plain words and Ullbek builds a real, custom website around it — actual pages written for you, not template blocks with a ceiling. Watch it come together through live preview links, ask for any change in plain language, and publish it to the web when it's ready. Every site gets a free address with free hosting included; premium hosting connects your own custom domain. No templates, no drag-and-drop, no coding — you describe it, it's built, it's live.
payload.longDescription: 用日常语言描述你的业务或想法，Ullbek 就会围绕它构建真正定制的网站——为你撰写实际页面，而不是受限的模板区块。通过实时预览链接查看网站逐步成形，用日常语言提出任何修改，并在准备就绪后发布到网上。每个网站都附带免费网址和免费托管；高级托管支持连接自定义域名。无需模板、拖放操作或编程——描述需求，网站即可建成并上线。

payload.name: Namsiang Thai Voice
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Cast Thai voices by gender, age, personality, and role; direct emotion and pacing line by line for drama, dubbing, and narration; then create, track, play, and download private audio directly in ChatGPT without exposing provider API keys or voice IDs.
payload.longDescription: 按性别、年龄、个性和角色选配泰语语音；逐行指导戏剧、配音和旁白的情绪与节奏；然后直接在 ChatGPT 中创建、跟踪、播放和下载私人音频，无需暴露服务提供商的 API 密钥或语音 ID。

payload.name: Motionvid
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: MotionVid turns a prompt or a script into a finished motion graphics video. Describe what you need, like an animated logo reveal, a product ad, a how-it-works explainer, an animated infographic or a map explainer, and MotionVid plans the scenes, animates them, adds narration and music, and renders an MP4 in 16:9, 9:16 or 1:1.  Pick a style such as claymation, paper collage or flat vector, apply your brand kit, preview frames before rendering, and ask for changes to an existing video without starting over. Works with your MotionVid account on any paid plan.
payload.longDescription: MotionVid 可以将提示词或脚本转化为完成的动态图形视频。描述你需要的内容，例如动画徽标展示、产品广告、操作说明视频、动画信息图或地图讲解；MotionVid 会规划场景、制作动画、添加旁白和音乐，并渲染为 16:9、9:16 或 1:1 的 MP4。选择黏土动画、剪纸拼贴或扁平矢量等风格，应用品牌套件，在渲染前预览画面，还可以要求修改现有视频，而无需从头开始。适用于任何付费套餐的 MotionVid 账户。

payload.name: Lawh.ai
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Lawh.ai turns a description into a real, layered design file in the user's own account rather than a flat image. It measures the text, computes the layout, prevents clipping, and reports layout or contrast problems so they can be fixed. Designs can be listed, previewed as images, opened in an interactive view where layers are dragged and text retyped, started from a hand-authored template library, organised into folders, and built with the user's own uploaded logos and images. Arabic and right-to-left layouts are supported natively. Finished work stays editable in the browser and exports as a layered Photoshop file with live text.
payload.longDescription: Lawh.ai 会根据描述在用户自己的账户中生成真正的分层设计文件，而非扁平图像。它会测量文本、计算布局、防止内容被裁切，并报告布局或对比度问题以便修复。你可以列出设计、预览图像、在交互视图中拖动图层并重新输入文字、从手工制作的模板库开始、将设计整理到文件夹中，也可以使用自己上传的标志和图像进行创作。原生支持阿拉伯语和从右到左的布局。完成的作品在浏览器中仍可编辑，并可导出为包含可编辑文本的分层 Photoshop 文件。

payload.name: AdsTurbo
payload.description: 制作 AI 广告视频和图像
payload.summaryOriginal: Make AI ad videos and images
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
AdsTurbo turns ChatGPT into an ad creative workstation. Connect your AdsTurbo account and ask ChatGPT to produce ad videos and product images directly in the conversation.

What it can do:
- Clone a competitor ad: analyze a reference video into a shot-by-shot storyboard and prompts, then generate a new video with the same structure.
- Generate video from text or images, including first/last-frame and multi-reference generation, plus extending or locally editing an existing video.
- Create digital-human spokesperson videos: pick a platform AI actor, clone a custom persona from a photo and voice sample, or lip-sync a portrait to an audio track (TTS included).
- Clean up finished videos: remove watermarks, logos and burnt-in subtitles, upscale to 2K/4K, and add or translate subtitles.
- Transform videos: swap the on-screen person, drive a static portrait with a reference video's motion, or translate a whole video into another language.
- Create and edit images for e-commerce: text-to-image, background removal, product and scene shots, campaign posters, and upscaling.

Generation runs as background tasks; ChatGPT returns a link to each finished video or image. All assets you provide must be publicly accessible URLs.

Requires an AdsTurbo account with a Pro plan or above. Generation consumes AdsTurbo credits according to your plan.
payload.longDescription:
AdsTurbo 将 ChatGPT 变为广告创意工作台。连接 AdsTurbo 账户，即可要求 ChatGPT 在对话中直接制作广告视频和商品图像。

它可以做什么：
- 复刻竞品广告：将参考视频分析为逐镜头分镜和提示词，再生成结构相同的新视频。
- 根据文字或图像生成视频，包括首尾帧生成和多参考素材生成，以及延长现有视频或对其进行局部编辑。
- 制作数字人代言视频：选择平台 AI 演员，根据照片和语音样本克隆自定义角色，或让人像与音轨对口型（包含 TTS）。
- 优化成片：移除水印、标志和内嵌字幕，提升至 2K/4K，并添加或翻译字幕。
- 转换视频：替换画面中的人物，使用参考视频的动作驱动静态人像，或将整个视频翻译成另一种语言。
- 创建和编辑电商图像：文生图、移除背景、商品与场景图、营销海报，以及提升分辨率。

生成过程作为后台任务运行；ChatGPT 会返回每个已完成视频或图像的链接。你提供的所有素材都必须使用可公开访问的 URL。

需要拥有 Pro 或更高套餐的 AdsTurbo 账户。生成会按照你的套餐消耗 AdsTurbo 积分。

payload.name: Treza
payload.description: 创建和编辑 AI 视频
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Treza makes and finishes videos from ChatGPT. Describe a video and Treza builds it with current video and image models, narration, music and captions, then renders it on your Treza account. You can also work with media you already have: join clips into one video over a voiceover and a music bed, or caption, upscale, crop or trim a single file.

What you can do:
- Start from a ready-made template, such as turning a long video or podcast into captioned vertical clips, or build a custom pipeline from a brief.
- Run a pipeline and follow it to the finished video.
- Check what a run will cost before spending, and see your credit balance.
- Browse the videos, images and audio your account has made.
- Add an image, video or audio file you attach or link, then edit it.
- Publish a pipeline and pause or resume its schedule.
- Connect your YouTube channel or TikTok account, and post a finished video after you review it. Nothing is posted until you press Post.

Runs spend prepaid credits from your Treza account. You sign in with Google when you connect, which creates a Treza account if you don't have one. Posting needs your own YouTube channel or TikTok account, which you connect from a link Treza gives you in the chat.
payload.longDescription:
Treza 可直接从 ChatGPT 制作并完成视频。描述你想要的视频，Treza 就会使用当前的视频和图像模型、旁白、音乐及字幕来制作，并在你的 Treza 账户中渲染。你也可以处理已有媒体：将多个片段与配音和背景音乐合并成一段视频，或为单个文件添加字幕、提升分辨率、裁剪画面或截短片段。

你可以：
- 从现成模板开始，例如将长视频或播客转换为带字幕的竖屏片段；也可以根据需求说明构建自定义流程。
- 运行流程并跟进，直到视频完成。
- 在消费前查看运行成本，并检查信用额度余额。
- 浏览账户制作的视频、图像和音频。
- 添加你附加或链接的图像、视频或音频文件，然后进行编辑。
- 发布流程，并暂停或恢复其计划安排。
- 连接你的 YouTube 频道或 TikTok 账户；审核完成视频后再发布。只有你点击“发布”后才会真正发布任何内容。

运行任务会消耗 Treza 账户中的预付信用额度。连接时使用 Google 登录；如果你还没有 Treza 账户，系统会为你创建一个。发布内容需要你自己的 YouTube 频道或 TikTok 账户；你可以通过 Treza 在聊天中提供的链接连接账户。

payload.name: Carat
payload.description: 创建 AI 图像和视频
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create images, video, audio, branded assets, and social content directly in ChatGPT. Start with an idea or reference files, and use Carat to plan, generate, review, edit, and export your work in one conversation.

With Carat, you can:

• Generate images and videos from text or reference media. Create portraits, illustrations, product visuals, cinematic scenes, social content, and ad creatives, or turn a still image into a video.
• Create product and brand content, including product photos, campaign visuals, short-form video ads, and coordinated social assets.
• Edit and transform existing media. Upload files for analysis, upscale images, create variations, and refine the results through conversation.
• Generate and work with audio for your creative projects.
• Inspect images, video, and audio before editing. Analyze uploaded content and technical metadata to choose suitable source material and workflows.
• Build and revise video projects in Carat Studio. Edit timelines, preview changes, and export the finished video.
• Review generated results in chat and build on previous creations without starting over.

Describe what you want to make and attach any references you need. From a single image to a multi-step video project, plan, create, and keep refining your work in the same conversation.

Connect your Carat account to get started. No separate API key is required. Generations use the same credit balance as the Carat platform.
payload.longDescription:
直接在 ChatGPT 中创建图像、视频、音频、品牌素材和社交内容。从一个想法或参考文件开始，使用 Carat 在同一段对话中规划、生成、审阅、编辑并导出作品。

借助 Carat，你可以：

• 根据文本或参考媒体生成图像和视频。创作肖像、插画、产品视觉图、电影感场景、社交内容和广告素材，或将静态图像转换为视频。
• 创建产品和品牌内容，包括产品照片、营销活动视觉素材、短视频广告和成套社交素材。
• 编辑并转换现有媒体。上传文件进行分析、提升图像分辨率、创建变体，并通过对话优化结果。
• 为创意项目生成和处理音频。
• 在编辑前检查图像、视频和音频。分析上传内容及其技术元数据，以选择合适的源素材和工作流程。
• 在 Carat Studio 中构建和修改视频项目。编辑时间线、预览更改并导出完成的视频。
• 在聊天中查看生成结果，并在此前创作的基础上继续完善，无需从头开始。

描述你想制作什么，并附上所需参考素材。从单张图像到多步骤视频项目，都可以在同一段对话中规划、创作并持续完善。

连接你的 Carat 账户即可开始。无需单独的 API 密钥。生成内容使用与 Carat 平台相同的额度余额。

payload.name: Uwear
payload.description: 创作 AI 时尚影像
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Uwear helps fashion teams organize garments, reusable models, locations, and art direction; prepare and approve photoshoot briefs; and generate, edit, and review product images and videos using their existing Uwear account and credits.
payload.longDescription: Uwear 帮助时尚团队整理服装、可重复使用的模特、场景和艺术指导，准备并审批拍摄简报，并使用现有 Uwear 账户和额度生成、编辑及审查产品图片和视频。

payload.name: Atlas Cloud
payload.description: 使用 400+ 模型创建媒体
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Generate images, videos, audio, 3D assets, and text with a live catalog of 400+ AI models. Choose video models such as Seedance, Veo, Kling, MiniMax, and Wan; image models such as GPT Image, Nano Banana, Seedream, FLUX, and Qwen; 3D models from Hunyuan and Tripo; plus audio models from Suno, ElevenLabs, MiniMax, and Seed Audio.

With this plugin, you can:
• Generate and edit images from text, images, or supported references.
• Create text-to-video, image-to-video, and reference-to-video clips; use supported video editing, avatar, and motion-control workflows.
• Turn text or images into 3D assets; create speech and music; transcribe audio; and run supported LLMs.
• Search the live model catalog, inspect each model’s inputs, output type, and pricing, upload source media for a generation task, and track asynchronous jobs to completion.

Connect your Atlas Cloud account in the browser—no API key is required. Billable jobs charge your Atlas balance and may require confirmation before submission. Availability, inputs, output formats, processing time, and cost vary by selected model. Uploads are temporary generation inputs, not permanent file storage.
payload.longDescription:
使用实时目录中的 400+ 个 AI 模型生成图片、视频、音频、3D 资产和文本。可选择 Seedance、Veo、Kling、MiniMax 和 Wan 等视频模型；GPT Image、Nano Banana、Seedream、FLUX 和 Qwen 等图像模型；Hunyuan 和 Tripo 的 3D 模型；以及 Suno、ElevenLabs、MiniMax 和 Seed Audio 的音频模型。

通过此插件，你可以：
• 根据文本、图片或支持的参考素材生成和编辑图片。
• 创建文生视频、图生视频和参考素材生成视频片段；使用支持的视频编辑、数字人和运动控制流程。
• 将文本或图片转为 3D 资产；创建语音和音乐；转录音频；运行支持的 LLM。
• 搜索实时模型目录，查看各模型的输入、输出类型和定价，上传生成任务所需的源媒体，并跟踪异步任务直至完成。

在浏览器中连接 Atlas Cloud 账号，无需 API 密钥。计费任务从你的 Atlas 余额扣费，提交前可能需要确认。可用性、输入、输出格式、处理时间和费用因所选模型而异。上传内容是临时生成输入，不是永久文件存储。

payload.name: Frameo.AI
payload.description: 将创意转化为完整视频
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Frameo turns a prompt into a finished short video inside ChatGPT. It generates images, video clips, voiceovers, music, and sound effects in the user's Frameo workspace, keeps characters and style consistent across shots, and assembles the clips with ffmpeg and motion-graphics templates into a final cut. Users can also upload or import their own media, browse a free sound-effect library, and read back a project's canvas and Library. Every credit-spending generation is quoted first with estimate_cost and runs only after the user confirms.
payload.longDescription: Frameo可在ChatGPT内将提示词生成完整短视频。它会在用户的Frameo工作区生成图片、视频片段、配音、音乐和音效，保持镜头间角色与风格的一致性，并通过ffmpeg和动态图形模板将片段剪辑成最终版本。用户还可上传或导入自有媒体，浏览免费音效库，并查看项目的画布和素材库。每次消耗积分的生成操作会先显示预估成本，待用户确认后才执行。

payload.name: Pedra
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Pedra is the AI photo and video studio for real estate agents. Connect your Pedra account and ask ChatGPT to prepare a listing's visuals.

Virtually stage empty rooms in the style you want, empty furnished rooms, renovate spaces with new floors and finishes, enhance lighting and straighten perspective, replace a dull sky with a blue one, remove objects, or blur faces and license plates. Describe any other edit in plain words, like "paint the walls sage green".

Pedra also turns a property's photos into a listing video with animated clips, background music, a narrated voiceover, and word-synced subtitles.

Everything you create is saved to your Pedra properties, so you can keep editing in the Pedra app. Requires a Pedra account; generations use your account's credits.
payload.longDescription:
Pedra 是面向房地产经纪人的 AI 照片与视频工作室。连接 Pedra 账户后，即可让 ChatGPT 为房源制作视觉素材。

可以按所需风格为空房间进行虚拟布置、清空已布置的房间、用新地板和饰面翻新空间、改善照明并校正透视、将阴沉的天空替换为蓝天、移除物体，或模糊人脸和车牌。也可以用日常语言描述其他编辑，例如“把墙刷成鼠尾草绿”。

Pedra 还可将房产照片制作成房源视频，包含动态片段、背景音乐、旁白和与语音同步的字幕。

创建的所有内容都会保存到您的 Pedra 房产项目中，之后可在 Pedra 应用里继续编辑。需要 Pedra 账户；生成内容会使用您账户中的额度。

payload.name: Marq
payload.description: 创建符合品牌规范的内容
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Marq is the Brand Enablement Platform for brand teams supporting creators across the organization. Connect Marq to ChatGPT to find brand templates and use them to create or update on-brand content like one-pagers, datasheets, and social posts. Use ChatGPT to inspect a project’s pages, text, images, and Smart Fields, then rewrite, proofread, or translate copy and replace images. You can also personalize content with user, team, or project information, populate documents from your Marq datasets, and apply Marq Brand Kit colors, fonts, and logos to supported template elements. Export finished projects as PDF, PNG, or JPG. Changes preserve existing styling and element locks, so teams can create and update content faster without losing brand or layout control. ChatGPT only works with content the signed-in user can access in Marq.
payload.longDescription: Marq 是面向品牌团队的品牌赋能平台，帮助团队支持组织各处的内容创作者。将 Marq 连接到 ChatGPT，查找品牌模板，并用它们创建或更新符合品牌规范的内容，例如单页介绍、数据表和社交媒体帖子。使用 ChatGPT 检查项目页面、文本、图像和 Smart Fields，然后改写、校对或翻译文案并替换图片。你也可以使用用户、团队或项目信息个性化内容，从 Marq 数据集填充文档，并将 Marq Brand Kit 的颜色、字体和标志应用于受支持的模板元素。可将完成的项目导出为 PDF、PNG 或 JPG。更改会保留现有样式和元素锁定，让团队更快创建和更新内容，同时保持品牌及版式控制。ChatGPT 只能处理已登录用户在 Marq 中有权访问的内容。

payload.name: Swish Sports Court Builder
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create custom basketball and other sports court designs with Swish Court Builder. Set dimensions, choose flooring and colors, adjust court markings and borders, and add sports lines, logos, and text. View 2D and 3D previews, download images or videos, and continue editing in Swish Court Builder. Customers can review and order physical court flooring through the Swish Court website.
payload.longDescription: 使用 Swish Court Builder 创建定制篮球场和其他运动场地设计。设置尺寸、选择地板和颜色、调整场地标线和边界，并添加运动线、徽标和文字。查看 2D 和 3D 预览，下载图片或视频，并在 Swish Court Builder 中继续编辑。顾客可以通过 Swish Court 网站查看并订购实体运动场地地板。

payload.name: PictureBooks
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create private illustrated storybooks from your ideas, follow generation progress, and read stories saved in your PictureBooks account. Built for parents, caregivers, educators, and other adult authors. Connect your existing account to check available credits and create books using those credits. The plugin does not purchase credits, charge a card, or publish your books. You can disconnect access in PictureBooks at any time.
payload.longDescription: 根据您的想法创作私人插画故事书、跟踪生成进度，并阅读保存在 PictureBooks 账户中的故事。面向家长、照护者、教育工作者和其他成年创作者。连接现有账户以查看可用额度，并使用这些额度创作图书。此插件不会购买额度、扣取银行卡费用，也不会发布您的图书。您可随时在 PictureBooks 中断开连接。

payload.name: Details.so
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Details helps you find curated website design references, inspect images and ordered video frames, and retrieve reusable web interface resources from the Details Vault. Search by section, component, style, or interaction, compare numbered results, then inspect a selected reference or retrieve a resource's implementation instructions and documentation. A connected Details account with an eligible plan is required; available tools and usage allowances depend on your account.
payload.longDescription: Details可以帮助您找到精选的网站设计参考，检查图片和有序的视频帧，并从Details Vault中检索可重复使用的网络界面资源。通过部分、组件、样式或交互方式搜索，比较编号结果，然后检查选定的参考内容或获取资源的实现说明和文档。需要连接一个符合条件的Details账户；可用工具和使用额度取决于您的账户。

payload.name: Planner5D: Plan, Build, Create
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Plan a renovation, see how furniture fits, explore a new home, or create visuals for your next project.
Create and edit floor plans, try different layouts, arrange furniture, and visualize interiors, buildings, and outdoor spaces in 2D and 3D. Explore ideas for your own home, client projects, or property presentations.
Turn photos, sketches, and references into images and videos. Compare styles, materials, and design options, or create visual content beyond home design.
Work with plans, specifications, quotes, and project documents. Organize materials and costs, compare options, and prepare clear briefs and presentations.
Start with an idea, a photo, a floor plan, or your project files. Develop your work through conversation and continue refining it in Planner 5D.
payload.longDescription:
规划翻新项目，查看家具适配情况，探索新家概念，或为下一个项目创建视觉效果。
创建和编辑平面图，尝试不同布局，摆放家具，并以2D和3D形式可视化室内空间、建筑结构和户外区域。
为自己的家、客户项目或房产展示探索设计构思。
将照片、草图和参考资料转化为图像和视频。
对比不同风格、材质和设计方案，或制作超越家居设计的视觉内容。
处理平面图、规格说明、报价单和项目文件。
整理材料与成本，对比选择方案，并制作清晰的方案说明和演示文稿。
从一个构思、一张照片、一份平面图或您的项目文件开始。
通过对话式协作完善作品，并在Planner 5D中持续优化。

payload.name: WonderWorks
payload.description: 生成 AI 视频与媒体
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bring your creative vision to life with WonderWorks AI. Generate stunning images, cinematic video clips, multi-shot storyboards, original music, and immersive sound effects directly from your conversation. Turn a story idea into a visually consistent sequence of key images that can become a long-form video. Use detailed prompts and reference images to control composition, style, characters, and visual continuity. Animate images into video, direct camera movement and on-screen action, and create the perfect soundtrack for your story. Ideal for filmmakers, content creators, marketers, and anyone turning ideas into compelling visual experiences.
payload.longDescription: 借助 WonderWorks AI 将创意变为现实。直接在对话中生成精美图像、电影感视频片段、多镜头故事板、原创音乐和沉浸式音效。将故事构想转化为视觉风格一致的一系列关键图像，并进一步制作成长篇视频。使用详细提示和参考图像控制构图、风格、角色和视觉连贯性。将图像制作成动画视频，指导镜头运动和画面动作，并为故事创作完美配乐。适合电影制作人、内容创作者、营销人员以及任何希望将创意转化为引人入胜视觉体验的人。

payload.name: Vectorize
payload.description: 将徽标转换为可编辑的 SVG
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Vectorize converts PNG, JPEG, and WebP logos into editable SVG revisions. Users can inspect and refine colors, curve smoothing, background removal, and framing in an interactive preview, then download an approved SVG or generate a complete brand kit.
payload.longDescription: Vectorize 可将 PNG、JPEG 和 WebP 格式的徽标转换为可编辑的 SVG 版本。用户可以在交互式预览中检查和调整颜色、曲线平滑度、背景移除效果和画面构图，然后下载经批准的 SVG，或生成完整的品牌套件。

payload.name: Orisu
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Orisu helps users create, inspect, edit, run, and share node-based workflows for generating AI images, video, audio, and text. Users can manage reusable apps and brand kits, validate workflow graphs, estimate run costs, monitor executions, and review generated outputs from ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Orisu帮助用户创建、检查、编辑、运行和共享用于生成AI图像、视频、音频和文本的节点式工作流。用户可以管理可重用的应用程序和品牌工具包，验证工作流图，估算运行成本，监控执行情况，并审查来自ChatGPT的生成输出。

payload.name: AI Humanizer
payload.description: 让 AI 文字更像真人写作
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Transform your AI-generated content into natural, human-like text with the ultimate AI Humanizer  tool. This ai-to-human text converter effortlessly converts output from AI to humanized text.
payload.longDescription: 使用强大的 AI Humanizer 工具，将 AI 生成的内容转为自然、如同真人撰写的文字。这款 AI 转真人文本转换器可轻松将 AI 输出转换为更具人味的文本。

payload.name: Taste
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find and browse designs you have saved in Taste. Search your references and collections, view designs in a visual gallery, and use your taste profile to guide design work. Connect your Taste account to access your library.
payload.longDescription: 查找并浏览你保存在 Taste 中的设计。搜索参考资料和合集，在视觉图库中查看设计，并利用你的品味档案指导设计工作。连接 Taste 账户即可访问你的资料库。

payload.name: Arcads
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Arcads helps users create and edit advertising videos, images, speech, and music in their workspace. Users can browse brands, actors, voices, and collected competitor ads; upload reference media; generate assets with supported models; and trim, combine, caption, translate, animate, or enhance existing media. AI analysis and prompt building support creative preparation. Processing runs as saved jobs and may consume workspace credits.
payload.longDescription:
Arcads帮助用户在其工作区中创建和编辑广告视频、图片、语音及音乐。
用户可浏览品牌、演员、配音及收集的竞品广告；上传参考素材；通过支持的模型生成素材；并对现有媒体进行修剪、合并、添加字幕、翻译、动画制作或增强处理。
AI分析与提示构建功能可辅助创意准备。
处理过程以已保存任务形式运行，可能消耗工作区积分。

payload.name: Tolstoy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Tolstoy brings your ecommerce content workflow into ChatGPT.

If you're a Tolstoy merchant, you can create marketing creative, manage your media library, browse your product catalog, build onsite widgets, and review ad performance without leaving chat.

What you can do:
  • "Create a square product image of our new ceramic mug on a clean studio background" — generate with the Studio creative agent, then refine it
  • "Show me my 20 most recent library assets" — browse, search, rename, and favorite your videos and images
  • "What stores are connected, and show me a few products from my catalog"
  • "List my onsite widgets and show me one's configuration"
  • "Show me my best-performing Meta ads from the last 30 days"
payload.longDescription:
Tolstoy将您的电商内容工作流程带入ChatGPT。

如果您是Tolstoy商家，您可以创建营销素材、管理媒体库、浏览产品目录、构建站内小部件并查看广告表现，而无需离开聊天界面。

您可以执行以下操作：
  • "在干净的摄影棚背景中生成我们新型陶瓷杯的方形产品图" — 通过工作室创意代理生成后进行微调
  • "展示给我我最近的20个媒体库资源" — 浏览、搜索、重命名并收藏您的视频和图片
  • "哪些店铺已连接，能给我展示一些目录中的产品吗"
  • "列出我的站内小部件并展示其中一个配置"
  • "展示我过去30天表现最佳的Meta广告"

payload.name: drawDash - Sketch Challenge!
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
How good is your drawing?

A quick easy game to play with ChatGPT.

Start the game, you get an object to draw and 60s to draw it in. When you're done, ChatGPT will guess.

Good luck!
payload.longDescription:
你的绘画水平如何？

一款可以与ChatGPT互动的快速小游戏。

开始游戏后，你会获得一个需要绘制的物体，并有60秒时间完成绘制。完成绘制后，ChatGPT将进行猜测。

祝你好运！

payload.name: WalkMyPlan — Floor Plans in 3D
payload.description: 通过聊天进行 3D 家居设计
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Describe the home you want — "a 10 by 10 house with a master bedroom and a private bathroom, two kids' rooms, an open kitchen and living room, a garden with trees" — and WalkMyPlan builds it in one go: real walls, doors, windows, furniture and garden. Open the live link and walk through it in 3D.

Keep designing in conversation. "Make the living room bigger." "Put a TV on the north wall." "I marked pin A — put the front door exactly there." Furniture placement is automatic — it finds a free spot, away from doorways. Every edit lands in a revision history you can undo or roll back to any point. Edits are for visualization and planning; WalkMyPlan does not check structural safety or building codes.

Ask about what you built. "How big is the kitchen?", "Is there room for a double bed in the small bedroom?" Answers are measured from the model's real geometry.

Share and collaborate. Share a plan privately with named people as viewers or editors, or with a link. See who changed what, when.

Already have a plan? Upload the real CAD file your architect sent — DWG or vector PDF, up to 100MB — and WalkMyPlan converts it into the same editable, walkable 3D model, so you start from reality instead of a blank page.

Great for home design, interior design, room planning, renovation, and planning a build. Your plans stay private to your account unless you share them, are never used to train AI models, and can be deleted any time (trash keeps them recoverable for 30 days).

Try: "Build me a three-bedroom house with a garden" — then "walk me through it."
payload.longDescription:
描述你想要的房子——例如“建一栋 10 by 10 的房子，带一间主卧和独立浴室、两间儿童房、开放式厨房和客厅，以及有树的花园”——WalkMyPlan 就能一次生成真实的墙壁、门窗、家具和花园。打开实时链接，以 3D 方式漫游其中。

在对话中继续设计：“把客厅加大。”“在北墙放一台电视。”“我标记了 A 点——把前门准确放在那里。”家具会自动摆放到远离门口的空位。每次编辑都会进入修订历史，你可以撤销，也可以恢复到任意历史版本。编辑仅供可视化和规划；WalkMyPlan 不会检查结构安全或建筑规范。

询问你创建的模型，例如“厨房有多大？”“小卧室里能放一张双人床吗？”答案根据模型的实际几何尺寸测量得出。

分享与协作。你可以将方案私下分享给指定人员，设置为查看者或编辑者，也可以通过链接分享。查看谁在何时更改了什么。

已经有方案？上传建筑师发给你的真实 CAD 文件——DWG 或矢量 PDF，最大 100MB——WalkMyPlan 会将其转换为同样可编辑、可漫游的 3D 模型，让你从现实方案开始，而不是从空白页面开始。

适用于住宅设计、室内设计、房间规划、翻新和建筑规划。除非你主动分享，否则方案会保存在你的账户中并保持私密；方案绝不会用于训练 AI 模型，你可以随时删除（垃圾箱会保留 30 天，以便恢复）。

试试：“帮我建一栋带花园的三居室房子”，然后说“带我参观一下”。

payload.name: Pitch
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Build on-brand decks directly from ChatGPT, pulling from the context you’ve already connected. Pitch creates whatever you describe in your template’s style, or fills in variables from your data for precise results. Search your decks and reuse their content, organize your workspace, set up share links, and track engagement.
payload.longDescription: 直接在 ChatGPT 中制作符合品牌风格的演示文稿，并利用您已连接的上下文。Pitch 会按照模板风格创建您描述的内容，也可以将数据填入变量以获得准确结果。搜索演示文稿并重用其中内容、整理工作区、设置分享链接并跟踪互动情况。

payload.name: Room Renovation Visualizer
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Preview realistic room renovations from a room photo or labelled floor plan. Renovate, declutter, or empty a room, then keep materials, openings, furniture, and room corrections consistent across the unit.
payload.longDescription: 根据房间照片或带标注的平面图，预览逼真的房间翻新效果。你可以翻新房间、清理杂物或清空房间，并在整个单元中保持材料、开口、家具和房间修正的一致性。

payload.name: AppLaunchFlow
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create app-store screenshots, social graphics, promo videos, and animated device mockups from your app screenshots. Browse your projects and uploaded assets, upload new assets, compare personalized screenshot and social styles, and preview three promo-video concepts. Interactive pickers appear in supported clients, with browser links as a fallback. You choose a style before a variant is created. Edit the results in your connected AppLaunchFlow account.
payload.longDescription: 根据应用截图创建应用商店截图、社交媒体图形、宣传视频和动态设备样机。浏览项目和已上传素材、上传新素材、比较个性化的截图与社交媒体风格，并预览 3 个宣传视频创意。在支持的客户端中会出现交互式选择器，浏览器链接作为备用方式。创建变体前由你选择风格。在已连接的 AppLaunchFlow 账户中编辑结果。

payload.name: Laotan AI Copywriting
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Laotan AI Copywriting Agent Hub provides multiple specialized copywriting workflows and lets users select or switch between different agents based on their needs.

The plugin uses protected agent configurations, specialist workflow modules, and private knowledge resources to assist with copywriting, rewriting, polishing, structural optimization, and content review.

Users can switch the active agent within the same conversation and continue working according to that agent’s specific writing rules and workflow. When proprietary reference material is needed, the plugin retrieves knowledge associated with the active agent.

Protected agent configurations and knowledge resources are available only to authorized users. Content generation is performed by the ChatGPT model currently used by the user. The service does not request the user’s ChatGPT password and does not call the OpenAI API on the user’s behalf.
payload.longDescription:
Laotan AI Copywriting Agent Hub 提供多个专业文案工作流，用户可根据需求选择或切换不同智能体。

该插件使用受保护的智能体配置、专业工作流模块和私有知识资源，协助完成文案创作、改写、润色、结构优化和内容审阅。

用户可以在同一对话中切换当前智能体，并按照该智能体专属的写作规则和工作流继续操作。需要专有参考资料时，插件会检索与当前智能体关联的知识。

受保护的智能体配置和知识资源仅对获授权用户开放。内容由用户当前使用的 ChatGPT 模型生成。该服务不会索取用户的 ChatGPT 密码，也不会代表用户调用 OpenAI API。

payload.name: ShirtLab
payload.description: 用 AI 图像设计 T 恤
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create typography previews or place selected PNG, JPEG and WebP artwork, including images generated in ChatGPT, on a black shirt. A clickable result card opens editable layers in the completely free ShirtLab studio. Move and resize artwork, export an editable .shirtlab project, or download the current print area as a transparent PNG. Export downloads happen in the studio. The MCP imports existing files; native ChatGPT image generation and file availability depend on the host and may require a separate message. No ShirtLab account or AI credits are needed. Image snapshots are accessible to anyone holding their link and expire after 24 hours. Buying a physical printed shirt is optional through website checkout.
payload.longDescription: 创建字体排版预览，或将选定的 PNG、JPEG 和 WebP 作品（包括在 ChatGPT 中生成的图像）放到黑色 T 恤上。点击结果卡片即可在完全免费的 ShirtLab 工作室中打开可编辑图层。移动和调整作品大小、导出可编辑的 .shirtlab 项目，或将当前印花区域下载为透明 PNG。导出文件需在工作室中下载。MCP 可导入现有文件；原生 ChatGPT 图像生成功能和文件可用性取决于宿主环境，可能需要另发一条消息。无需 ShirtLab 账户或 AI 积分。任何持有图像快照链接的人都可以访问，且链接会在 24 小时后失效。是否通过网站结账购买实体印花 T 恤由你自行选择。

payload.name: Vivu
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search indexed video libraries, find precise moments, open playable previews, summarize videos, and manage projects and uploads from ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: 搜索已编入索引的视频库，定位准确片段，打开可播放预览，概述视频，并通过 ChatGPT 管理项目和上传内容。

payload.name: Zim Studio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Turn products, references and scripts into images, videos and audio with Zim Studio. Plan campaigns, write copy and UGC scripts, create stills and carousel assets, and develop cinematic scenes. Edit existing videos with Mirage, Clone and Angles, create storyboards, and organize results in projects. Creative skills help with direction, continuity, formats and review criteria. Connect your Zim Studio account to use your library, brand knowledge and available features. Check the cost before generating; media creation uses your existing Zim Studio credits.
payload.longDescription: 使用 Zim Studio 将产品、参考素材和脚本转化为图片、视频和音频。规划营销活动、撰写文案和 UGC 脚本、创建静态图与轮播素材，并制作电影感场景。使用 Mirage、Clone 和 Angles 编辑现有视频，创建故事板，并在项目中整理结果。创意技能可帮助处理创意方向、连贯性、格式和审核标准。连接 Zim Studio 账号即可使用你的素材库、品牌知识和可用功能。生成前请查看成本；媒体创作会使用你现有的 Zim Studio 点数。

payload.name: Templated
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Templated is an API and drag-and-drop editor for generating images, videos and PDFs from reusable templates. Design a template once (or import it from Canva), then let ChatGPT render it with new text, images and colors on demand.

With this app ChatGPT can:
- Render images (PNG, JPG, WebP), multi-page PDFs and MP4 videos from any of your templates by changing layer values
- Browse, search and inspect your templates, layers and pages to know what can be customized
- Create, update, clone and organize templates and folders
- Upload images and fonts from URLs and manage your assets
- Merge PDF renders and check your account usage

Renders are produced by Templated's rendering engine from templates you designed, so the output is consistent, on-brand and ready to use in marketing, e-commerce, social media, documents and automations. Sign in with your Templated account when connecting.
payload.longDescription:
Templated 是一个 API 和拖放式编辑器，可利用可重复使用的模板生成图像、视频和 PDF。设计一次模板（或从 Canva 导入），之后即可让 ChatGPT 按需替换文字、图像和颜色并渲染成品。

使用此应用，ChatGPT 可以：
- 修改图层值，从任意模板渲染图像（PNG、JPG、WebP）、多页 PDF 和 MP4 视频
- 浏览、搜索和检查模板、图层及页面，了解可自定义内容
- 创建、更新、克隆并整理模板和文件夹
- 从 URL 上传图像和字体，并管理资源
- 合并 PDF 渲染结果并查看账户用量

渲染结果由 Templated 的渲染引擎根据你设计的模板生成，因此输出一致、符合品牌风格，可用于营销、电商、社交媒体、文档和自动化流程。连接时请使用你的 Templated 账户登录。

payload.name: VOSU
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: VOSU generates images, videos and 3D models with leading AI models using the user's existing VOSU account and credits. Users describe what they want and pick a model, animate a photo they upload into a short video, turn an image into a 3D model, and browse, replay or download everything they have generated. Every prompt passes a content-safety check before anything is charged, and the credit balance can be checked before any spend.
payload.longDescription: VOSU 使用领先的 AI 模型生成图像、视频和 3D 模型，并使用用户现有的 VOSU 账户和额度。用户可以描述想要的内容并选择模型，将上传的照片制作成短视频，将图像转为 3D 模型，还可以浏览、重播或下载生成的所有内容。每条提示都会先经过内容安全检查，之后才会扣费；消费前可查询额度余额。

payload.name: Descry
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Descry is a connected creative-production workspace for books, film, games, podcasts, video, and nonfiction research. Find and retrieve project material, create and revise works and content, organize project entities and assets, manage scenes and lore, relate places and ideas, and review research sources and claims. Descry acts as the signed-in user and respects workspace and project permissions on every call.
payload.longDescription: Descry 是一个互联的创意制作工作区，适用于图书、电影、游戏、播客、视频和非虚构研究。查找并获取项目资料，创作和修订作品及内容，整理项目实体与素材，管理场景和设定，关联地点与创意，并审阅研究来源和主张。Descry 以已登录用户的身份操作，并在每次调用时遵循工作区和项目权限。

payload.name: BrandLife
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bring your brand assets into your AI assistant. BrandLife MCP Server lets ChatGPT search, browse and organise your brands, collections and assets.
payload.longDescription: 将品牌资产带入你的 AI 助手。BrandLife MCP Server 让 ChatGPT 能够搜索、浏览和整理你的品牌、集合及资产。

payload.name: Pray Production Studio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Pray Production Studio helps you turn creative ideas into AI video projects. Search your PPS projects, view project details, plan trailers, and render trailer videos from ChatGPT. Video generation uses credits in your PPS workspace, and the tools available depend on your account access and enabled providers.
payload.longDescription: Pray Production Studio帮助您将创意想法转化为AI视频项目。搜索您的PPS项目，查看项目详情，规划预告片，并从ChatGPT生成预告片视频。视频生成会消耗PPS工作区的积分，可用工具取决于您的账户权限和已启用的服务提供商。

payload.name: Property Video
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create concise 10–12 second real-estate video scripts for development overviews and room-by-room tours. The workflow guides intake one question at a time, keeps project settings consistent, writes Singapore Standard English dialogue, and produces shot guidance, captions, hashtags, and Seedance-ready prompts.
payload.longDescription: 为开发概述和逐房间导览制作简洁的10-12秒房地产视频脚本。工作流程每次引导处理一个问题，保持项目设置一致，撰写新加坡标准英语对话，并生成镜头指导、字幕、标签和Seedance就绪的提示。

payload.name: Nonica
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The NonicaTab A.I. Connector is a local MCP server for Revit. Once installed, it lets you query, edit and document the model open on your PC by asking in plain language. This plugin is the guide to it.

Ask how to install it, where to download it, how to connect it to your AI client, or what any of its 50+ tools do:

Read (38 tools, free): find elements by category, family or type; bulk-read parameters; inspect geometry, hosts and materials; audit warnings, worksets and family sizes; review schedules, sheets and view filters.
Edit (11 tools, PRO): set parameters in bulk, move, rotate, copy or delete, override colors, isolate elements, manage sheet revisions.
Create (15 tools, PRO): grids, levels, plans, sections, room elevations, sheets, schedules, tags, text notes — then export to PDF or DWG.

Search the catalogue by keyword to get any tool's arguments, limits and edition.

Documentation only — no access to your models, files or account. The connector that touches your model runs locally on your machine.
payload.longDescription:
NonicaTab A.I. 连接器是适用于 Revit 的本地 MCP 服务器。安装后，您可以通过自然语言提问，对电脑上的模型进行查询、编辑和文档记录。这是该插件的使用指南。

询问安装方法、下载地址、如何连接到您的 AI 客户端，或了解其 50 多个工具中的任意工具功能：

查看（38 个工具，免费）：通过分类、族或类型查找元素；批量读取参数；检查几何体、宿主和材质；审核警告信息、工作集和族大小；查看明细表、图纸和视图过滤器。编辑（11 个工具，专业版）：批量设置参数，移动、旋转、复制或删除元素，覆盖颜色，隔离元素，管理图纸修订。创建（15 个工具，专业版）：创建网格、标高、平面、剖面、房间剖面、图纸、明细表、标记、文字注释——然后导出为 PDF 或 DWG。

通过关键词搜索目录，获取任意工具的参数说明、使用限制和版本信息。

仅提供文档说明——不访问您的模型、文件或账户。接触模型的连接器在您本地计算机上运行。

payload.name: Creatify Ad Agent
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create video ads from a product brief and reference media. Review generated footage, adjust shots, captions, music and calls to action, then export a finished take through Creatify. A Creatify account and available credits are required for generation and shipping.
payload.longDescription: 从产品简报和参考素材创建视频广告。审查生成的素材，调整镜头、字幕、音乐和行动呼吁，然后通过Creatify导出最终版本。创建和发货需要Creatify账户和可用积分。

payload.name: SkeuDesign
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find PNG icons for websites, apps and presentations. Search every category, compare previews, collect a matching set in Icon Tray, and export selected files. Every connected account can use up to 20 fixed icons per category. Existing library entitlements include the full collection. Custom icon generation is not included.
payload.longDescription: 为网站、应用程序和演示文稿寻找PNG图标。搜索每个类别，比较预览图，将匹配的图标收集至图标托盘，并导出所选文件。每个已连接的账户每类最多可使用20个固定图标。现有库权限包含完整图库。不包含自定义图标生成。

payload.name: RiffAds
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: RiffAds makes UGC-style video ads. Pick an AI actor, give it a script, and get a finished talking actor video for your product. It also makes images, short videos, voice-overs and music for the same campaign. Attach a product photo or a clip in the chat to use it. Edit what you make too: add captions, remove a background, trim, resize, change the voice or put text on it. Every result is saved to your RiffAds workspace library with a permanent link, and a player shows it right in the chat. Open the RiffAds Studio from the sidebar or beside a chat to browse everything you made, pick a file to use, choose an actor, a voice and the settings, and follow running jobs. RiffAds asks you before it starts any work and never posts anything to a social network.
payload.longDescription: RiffAds制作用户生成内容风格的视频广告。选择一位AI演员，提供一段剧本，即可为您的产品生成完成的真人出镜视频。它还能为同一场营销活动制作图片、短视频、配音和背景音乐。在聊天中上传产品图片或视频片段即可使用。您也可以对创作内容进行编辑：添加字幕、去除背景、剪辑裁剪、调整尺寸、更换音色或添加文字。所有生成结果都会保存到您的RiffAds工作区资料库，并附带永久链接，播放器可直接在聊天中展示。从侧边栏或聊天窗口旁打开RiffAds Studio，可浏览所有创作内容，选择文件使用，挑选演员、音色和设置参数，并查看运行中的任务。RiffAds在开始任何工作前会征得您的同意，且永远不会将内容发布到社交网络。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Make talking actor video ads, Generate images and short videos, Create voice-overs and music, Edit video, images and audio, Browse your creations and set up new ones in the RiffAds Studio

payload.name: NameSTL
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create and edit 3D names from your conversation. Choose fonts, colors, thickness and bases for name signs, keychains, pet tags, cake toppers and two-name flip designs. Refine the interactive preview, then connect a NameSTL account to save and reopen designs. Export STL and 3MF files when your connected account has export access. NameSTL explains account access limits when a download is unavailable. File preparation uses a WebGL-capable browser; set the final print size in your slicer. NameSTL creates model files for you to print yourself.
payload.longDescription:
通过对话创建和编辑3D名称
选择字体、颜色、厚度和底座，用于名称标志、钥匙扣、宠物牌、蛋糕装饰及双名翻转设计
优化交互式预览后，连接NameSTL账户保存并重新打开设计
当已连接账户具备导出权限时，可导出STL和3MF文件
当无法下载时，NameSTL会说明账户访问限制
文件准备需使用支持WebGL的浏览器；在切片软件中设置最终打印尺寸
NameSTL为您生成可自行打印的模型文件

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Preview 3D names, Save account designs, Read saved designs, Use existing STL and 3MF export access

payload.name: Ad Army
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create and edit images, generate videos and voiceovers, analyse media, and assemble video cuts using your connected Ad Army workspace.

For creators, marketers, and agencies, Ad Army brings creative generation and review into the conversation. Explore product image variations, turn a still image into a video, analyse existing footage, or assemble a shorter cut. Find available models and supported settings, check credit estimates, and save notes and results to Playground boards for continued work in Ad Army.

Connect an Ad Army account and choose the workspace and permissions the assistant may use. Generations, analysis, and renders use that workspace's existing credits. Approve a total workflow budget before paid work; per-operation limits also apply. Available models, settings, and processing times vary. Importing or uploading external assets requires an additional permission. Review generated content before using or publishing it.
payload.longDescription:
通过已连接的Ad Army工作区创建和编辑图像，生成视频和配音，分析媒体内容，并剪辑视频片段。

对于创作者、营销人员和代理商，Ad Army将创意生成与评审融入对话流程。探索产品图像变体，将静态图像转换为视频，分析现有素材，或制作精简剪辑版本。查看可用模型和支持的设置，查看信用预估，将笔记和结果保存至Playground看板以便在Ad Army中继续工作。

连接Ad Army账户并选择助手可使用的具体工作区和权限。生成内容、分析素材及渲染作品将使用该工作区的现有信用额度。付费工作前需批准总工作流预算，同时适用每操作限制。可用模型、设置及处理时间可能有所差异。导入或上传外部资源需要额外权限。使用前请审核生成内容。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Create and edit images, Generate videos and voiceovers, Analyse media, Assemble video cuts, Manage Playground boards

payload.name: FreeTTS
payload.description: 文本转语音，支持149种语言
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Turn any text into natural speech and get an MP3 link you can play or download.

Choose from 2,253 voices in 149 languages and regional accents, or ask FreeTTS to suggest three voices for your language and purpose, from audiobooks and lessons to ads and podcasts.

Record a dialogue with a different voice for each speaker, build timed tracks with exact pauses, beeps and dings for presenters, actors, teachers and video voiceovers, and turn an audio link into text.

Some features, such as HD voices, dialogue, timed tracks and transcription, work once you connect your FreeTTS account.
payload.longDescription:
将任何文本转换为自然语音，并获取可播放或下载的MP3链接。

在149种语言和地区口音中选择2,253种语音，或让FreeTTS根据您的语言和用途推荐三种语音，涵盖有声书、课程、广告和播客等场景。

为每位说话者使用不同语音录制对话，为演讲者、演员、教师和视频配音制作包含精确停顿、提示音和提示音的定时轨道，并将音频链接转换为文本。

部分功能（如高清语音、对话、定时轨道和语音转文字）在连接FreeTTS账户后即可使用。

payload.name: MapPoster
payload.summaryOriginal: Map poster gifts and wall art
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
MapPoster turns the places in your life into a map poster: a personal gift for someone you love, or wall art for your own home.

Tell ChatGPT the occasion and the place, and MapPoster designs the poster right in the chat. Make a map of the street where you met as an anniversary or Valentine's gift, or of the venue where a couple got married as a wedding gift. Give friends a housewarming gift of their first home with a heart on their new street, or give someone who is moving away a map of their hometown. You can also map the city of a honeymoon or a road trip, or a baby's birthplace in soft pastels for the nursery.

Every poster is a map of a real place: a city, neighborhood, street address or landmark, in one of 50+ styles. Add your own title, names, a date, coordinates or a short message in 14 fonts, a heart or marker on the exact spot and a driving route on the map. Make it a heart-shaped, round or hexagon map, or add a gallery mat. One poster can also hold up to three places, each with its own map and label: where you met, got engaged and got married, or two cities for a long-distance couple.

You see a preview of the poster in the conversation and can try other styles and move the map right there. Screen-size designs in 15 of the styles can be downloaded as a PNG (up to 1080 px, with a small watermark). Every design opens in the MapPoster editor at mapposter.xyz to fine-tune it, and posters in the drawn map styles can be ordered there as a printed poster (from A4), a framed print or a canvas, up to 18x24 in, plus square sizes, shipped to you or straight to the person it's for.

What you can ask for:
- Map wall art for a living room, home office, dorm or nursery
- Styles from minimalist black and white and vintage-style to blueprint, dark, neon, pastel and rose gold
- Sizes for prints, square frames, Instagram and phone or desktop wallpapers

Limits: up to three places per poster; a poster with several places is rectangular, with the markers and route on its first map. Routes are driving routes. The chat preview leaves out street names; the classic city map styles show them in the editor. Prints ship to 20 countries, including the US, Canada, the UK, much of Europe, Australia and Japan.

Street maps are drawn from OpenStreetMap data. MapPoster needs no account and doesn't store your posters or your conversation.
payload.longDescription:
MapPoster将你生活中的地点转化为地图海报：一份送给所爱之人的个性化礼物，或装饰你家的墙艺作品。

告诉ChatGPT场合和地点，MapPoster即可在聊天中直接设计海报。
为纪念相遇的街道制作周年纪念或情人节礼物，或为情侣婚礼制作场地地图作为结婚礼物。
给朋友送上他们首套房屋的搬家礼物，在新街道上标注爱心，或为即将远行的人制作家乡地图。
你也可以绘制蜜月旅行或公路旅行的城市地图，或用柔和的马卡龙色系制作婴儿房的出生地地图。

每张海报都是真实地点的地图：城市、社区、街道地址或地标，提供50多种风格。
在14种字体中选择标题、姓名、日期、坐标或简短信息，添加爱心或标记在精确位置，并在地图上显示驾车路线。
可制作心形、圆形、六边形地图，或添加画廊边框。
一张海报最多可包含三个地点，每个地点单独标注地图和标签：相遇地、求婚地和结婚地，或远距离情侣的两座城市。

对话中可预览海报效果，可直接尝试其他风格并调整地图位置。
15种风格的屏幕尺寸设计可下载为PNG格式（最高1080像素，带小水印）。
所有设计均可在mapposter.xyz的MapPoster编辑器中精细调整，手绘风格地图可直接订购印刷品（A4起）、装裱画或画布（最大18x24英寸），另提供方形尺寸，可寄送至您或礼物接收人。

可请求的内容：
- 适用于客厅、书房、宿舍或婴儿房的墙艺地图
- 风格涵盖极简黑白、复古风到蓝图、暗黑、霓虹、马卡龙色和玫瑰金
- 提供印刷品、方形相框、Instagram及手机/电脑壁纸尺寸

限制：每张海报最多三个地点；多地点海报为矩形，标记和路线仅显示在首张地图上。
路线为驾车路线。
聊天预览会省略街道名称；经典城市地图风格在编辑器中会显示街道名称。
印刷品可配送至20个国家，包括美国、加拿大、英国、大部分欧洲国家、澳大利亚和日本。

街道地图数据来源于OpenStreetMap。
MapPoster无需账户，且不会保存您的海报或聊天记录。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Adds a driving route and a gallery mat, or makes a heart-shaped, round or hexagon map, Opens every design in the MapPoster editor at mapposter.xyz to fine-tune it

payload.name: PlayDrop
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Make and improve browser games with your coding agent, then bring them to PlayDrop. Upload your game and its complete listing, playtest a private draft, and publish the version you tested to a shareable PlayDrop link.

Open Your games from the sidebar and compare Live and Draft beside your conversation. Use PlayDrop review feedback to improve your game and listing for distribution. Discovery eligibility depends on the game review; placement is not guaranteed.

Your source code stays in your own project. Games created in PlayDrop Studio open on the PlayDrop website. Local development uses the PlayDrop Dev page in a compatible browser.

A PlayDrop account is required.
payload.longDescription:
通过您的代码代理创建并改进浏览器游戏，然后将其带到PlayDrop。上传您的游戏及其完整清单，试玩私有草稿，并将经过测试的版本发布到可共享的PlayDrop链接。

从侧边栏打开您的游戏，在对话框旁同时查看实时版和草稿版。利用PlayDrop评审反馈优化游戏和清单以进行分发。发现资格取决于游戏审核；无法保证展示位置。

payload.name: MeiGen Gallery
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create and edit images and videos with MeiGen. Browse available models and workflow prices, find up to three visual inspirations, and turn a selected idea into an image or video. Remove or replace backgrounds, upscale images, create marketing posters, and generate selected product-detail images.

Connect a verified MeiGen account to use paid tools. Generations use your existing purchased credits; daily free credits do not apply. Review the current price and requested image count before starting. MeiGen does not sell credits or subscriptions through this plugin.

With your permission, prepare a selected image attachment or direct public image URL. Uploads are not automatically published to the gallery.

Recover an existing task after a timeout without starting another generation, and revoke access from MeiGen's Connected apps page. Image previews depend on the host; original result links remain available.
payload.longDescription:
通过MeiGen创建和编辑图片和视频。

移除或替换背景，放大图片，创建营销海报，并生成精选的产品详情图片。

连接经过验证的MeiGen账户以使用付费工具。

准备好的图片会获得公共链接，任何拥有该链接的人都可访问，且在最新上传后七天安排清理。
已接受的生成内容会保留独立参考副本用于历史记录和重复使用；如需删除请联系支持团队。
